sloka: ततः शुश्रुपुराक्रुष्टम् लङ्कायाः काननौकसः ।भेरीमृदङ्गसम्घुष्टम् तुमुलम् रोमहर्षणम् ॥६-२४-३॥।।
transliteration: tataḥ śuśrupurākruṣṭam laṅkāyāḥ kānanaukasaḥ ।bherīmṛdaṅgasamghuṣṭam tumulam romaharṣaṇam ॥6-24-3॥।।

translations.english: There upon having settled down, the army hordes heard from Lanka terrific and tumultuous noise of drums and percussion instruments that caused horripilation.
